connector.name: Idios
connector.registryDescription: Private escrow for AI agent work on Beam: verifiable delivery, worker collateral, M of N disputes.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package idios-mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the honeytones account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: IDIOS_WALLET_PASS
env.description: Beam wallet password. If unset the server prompts on stdin at startup, which fails in containers.
